## About
Lawrence Auto Repair is a mechanic shop on W Wilken Way in Anaheim, close to Disneyland. We handle everyday maintenance like oil changes and tune-ups, plus repairs on brakes, electrical systems, steering, suspension, cooling and more.
We use computerized engine diagnostics to find out what's going on with your car, and we keep a large inventory of parts in stock so you can get back on the road quickly.
Neighbors who have come back for years and travelers passing through on vacation have rated us 4.9 from 279 Google reviews. Many of them mention honest, friendly service.

## Services
- Computer diagnostics: Computer diagnostic and troubleshooting to find out what's wrong with your car.
- Check engine light problems: If your check engine light is on, bring it in and we'll look into it.
- Brake services: Brake work to keep you safe on the road.
- Oil change, lube and filter: Oil change, lube and filter for your car.
- Air conditioning service: Air conditioning service for your car.
- Electrical systems: Electrical systems service and repair.
- Steering and suspension: Steering and suspension services.
- Fuel pumps and lines: Fuel pump and fuel line repair.
- Smog check: Smog check for vehicles 2000 and up.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: All cars, including domestic, import and European models.

Q: Will my warranty be honored back home?
A: As a NAPA Auto Repair approved facility, our warranty is nationwide in the US and Canada. One out of state customer noted it can be honored by any NAPA auto care shop.

Q: Are you open on the weekend?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.
